titleEn: Bathroom Renovation Cost in Delta BC (2026): Real Project Data
titleZh: Delta浴室装修费用（2026）：真实项目数据
contentEn:
Delta homeowners spent $15,000 to $55,000 on bathroom renovations in 2025, with most mid-range projects falling between $25,000 and $43,000. Reno Stars has completed seven bathroom and whole-house renovation projects in Delta over the past two years, giving us precise cost visibility that goes beyond industry estimates. This guide uses those real numbers to show what you can expect to pay in Delta BC in 2026.

What Does a Bathroom Renovation Cost in Delta BC?

Delta bathroom renovation costs depend on the scope of work, the condition of the existing bathroom, and the finishes you choose. A basic refresh — new paint, vanity, toilet, and flooring — typically costs $15,000 to $22,000. A full renovation that moves plumbing, retiles the shower, and installs a new layout runs $28,000 to $43,000. A luxury master bath with heated floors, custom tile, high-end fixtures, and structural changes can reach $50,000 to $65,000.

These figures are drawn from Reno Stars project records in Delta. Every price below comes from an actual completed contract, not an estimate or industry average.

Reno Stars has completed projects in Delta's Tsawwassen, Ladner, and North Delta neighbourhoods. Tsawwassen homes tend to be newer detached properties with more layout flexibility for bathroom reconfigurations. Ladner and North Delta include both townhouses and older detached homes, where structural bathroom renovations may require additional subfloor work before new tile can be laid.

What Drives Delta Bathroom Renovation Costs

Three factors account for most of the variation in Delta bathroom renovation costs: plumbing relocation, shower and tile scope, and finish level.

Plumbing relocation is the biggest cost driver. Moving a toilet, shifting a shower drain, or re-routing supply lines requires a plumbing permit in Delta and adds $2,000 to $6,000 depending on distance. Keeping plumbing in place is the single most effective budget control measure.

Shower and tile scope matters more than fixture brand. A standard tile shower with a fixed glass panel runs $3,500 to $6,000 for materials and labour. A curbless accessible walk-in shower with a linear drain, multiple body jets, and natural stone tile can reach $12,000 to $18,000 before any plumbing changes.

Finish level covers vanity, countertop, faucet, and lighting choices. A solid-wood vanity with a quartz countertop and brushed-nickel faucet typically costs $2,500 to $5,000 more than a home-centre vanity-top combo. Most Delta clients Reno Stars works with choose mid-range finishes — solid-wood Shaker-style vanities, quartz countertops, and brushed gold or matte black hardware.

Delta-Specific Permit and Regulation Notes

Delta (Tsawwassen, Ladner, North Delta) falls under the Metro Vancouver building permit system. Bathroom renovations that move plumbing fixtures require a building permit from Delta's building department. Cosmetic renovations — replacing a vanity, retiling a shower floor without moving the drain, or upgrading fixtures — do not require a building permit, but any work on supply or drain lines requires a plumbing permit.

Tsawwassen Delta properties are subject to Metro Vancouver drainage and utilities bylaw. If your renovation involves adding a new shower on a slab foundation or moving a drain to a new location, a structural assessment may be required before permit approval. Reno Stars handles permit applications as part of standard project management — this service is included in our fee.

For Ladner properties built before 1960, if the home is in a heritage designation or heritage conservation area, an additional heritage review is required alongside the standard building permit. This can add approximately 2–4 weeks to the permit timeline.

How to Get an Accurate Delta Bathroom Renovation Quote

A precise quote requires a site visit so we can assess current conditions, measure existing fixtures, and identify any hidden issues behind walls. Reno Stars offers free on-site consultations for Delta homeowners. During the visit we measure your bathroom, discuss your finish preferences, and provide a fixed-price quote that covers everything — labour, materials, permits, and project management — with no hidden charges.

To book a free consultation call 604-593-7626 or use the contact form on this page.

2025年，Delta业主的浴室翻新费用在15,000至55,000加元之间，大多数中档项目的费用在25,000至43,000加元之间。Reno Stars在过去两年内在Delta完成了七个浴室及全屋翻新项目，使我们能够提供超越行业估算的精确成本数据。本指南使用这些真实数据，展示您在2026年Delta BC可以预期的装修费用。

Delta BC的浴室翻新费用是多少？

Delta浴室翻新费用取决于工程范围、现有浴室的状况以及您选择的饰面。基本翻新（新房漆、新洗手柜、马桶和地板）通常费用为15,000至22,000加元。全面翻新（移动管道、重新铺砖淋浴间、调整布局）费用为28,000至43,000加元。豪华主卧浴室配备地暖、定制瓷砖、高端五金件及结构改造，费用可高达50,000至65,000加元。

以下数据均来自Reno Stars在Delta的实际完成项目合同，非估算或行业平均值。

Delta真实项目费用

下表展示了Reno Stars最近在Delta完成的三个浴室翻新项目，包含实际合同金额、工程范围和工期。

3.5间浴室全面翻新三间全套浴室+洗手间；新淋浴间、浴缸、洗手柜，全部铺砖$40,000–$43,0007–9周
全屋翻新（含2间浴室）厨房+两间浴室+地板；Delta独立屋项目定价10–14周

Reno Stars曾在Delta的Tsawwassen、Ladner和北Delta社区完成项目。Tsawwassen的房产通常是较新的独立屋，浴室布局调整空间更大。Ladner和北Delta则包含联排别墅和较旧的独立屋，浴室结构翻新可能需要在铺设新瓷砖前进行额外的修补工作。

什么因素驱动Delta浴室翻新的成本

三个因素占Delta浴室翻新费用差异的大部分：管道迁移、淋浴间和铺砖范围，以及饰面档次。

管道迁移是最大的成本驱动因素。移动马桶、移动淋浴间排水管或重新布置供水管需要Delta的管道许可证，并根据距离额外增加2,000至6,000加元。保持管道位置不变是控制预算的最有效方式。

淋浴间和铺砖范围比五金品牌更重要。标准瓷砖淋浴间配固定玻璃隔板，材料和人工费用通常为3,500至6,000加元。无障碍步入式淋浴间配线性地漏、多个身体喷头和天然石材瓷砖，在任何管道改动之前就可能达到12,000至18,000加元。

饰面档次包括洗手柜、台面、水龙头和照明选择。实木洗手柜配石英石台面和拉丝镍五金，比家居商场的洗手柜+台面组合通常高出2,500至5,000加元。Delta市场的饰面选择偏向中档——Reno Stars在Delta合作的大多数业主选择实木Shaker风格洗手柜、石英石台面和拉丝金或哑光黑五金件。

Delta特有的许可证和法规说明

Delta（Tsawwassen、Ladner、北Delta）属于大温哥华建筑许可体系。移动管道装置的浴室翻新需要向Delta建筑部门申请建筑许可证。Cosmetic翻新——更换洗手柜、在不改变排水口位置的情况下重新铺淋浴间地板，或升级五金件——不需要建筑许可证，但任何供水或排水管道的工程都需要管道许可证。

Tsawwassen的Delta房产受大温哥华排水和公用设施法规约束。如果您的翻新涉及在板基础上新增淋浴间或将排水管移至新位置，可能需要在许可批准前进行结构评估。Reno Stars作为标准项目管理的一部分处理许可申请流程——此服务不额外收费。

对于Ladner社区1960年前建造的房产，如属保护区或位于保护区，则需额外进行保护区审查，连同标准建筑许可证一并审批。此项会使许可时间表延长约2–4周。

如何获得准确的Delta浴室翻新报价

精确的报价需要现场勘察，以便我们评估现有条件、测量固定装置尺寸，并识别墙内的潜在问题。Reno Stars为Delta业主提供免费现场咨询。勘察期间，我们会测量您的浴室、讨论饰面偏好，并提供包含所有项目——人工、材料、许可证和项目管理——在内的固定价格报价，绝无隐性收费。
